commands.environment: TEMP and TMP point to target/qianxing-test-temp

coverage: Binance single-child cancellation acquires the account admission lock before reading and validating the current EventLog order, then checks unresolved operations while the lock is held.

Binance native OCO group cancellation acquires the same account lock before loading the group snapshot and invokes the child cancellation through a lock-held internal entry point without reacquiring the non-reentrant lock.
The existing OMS cancellation and post-cancel full-list reconciliation path remains the sole order fact writer.
scope_limitations: This is local Windows service test evidence only; it does not establish Binance API race behavior or Sandbox acceptance.
No exchange API was called and no order was changed.
Binance Spot OCO remains implemented-unverified pending authorized Testnet lifecycle acceptance.
